# `redundantSchemaTagIdentifier`

Suggests removing redundant identifier argument when it equals the tag value in Schema.TaggedClass/TaggedError/TaggedRequest

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Category | Style |
| Default severity | `suggestion` |
| Fixable | Yes |
| Effect versions | v3, v4 |
| Diagnostic codes | `TS377045` |
| Language Service name | `redundantSchemaTagIdentifier` |
| Oxlint name | `effecttsgo/redundant-schema-tag-identifier` |

## Preview

```ts
import * as Schema from "effect/Schema"

export class Preview
  extends Schema.TaggedClass<Preview>("Preview")("Preview", {
/**
                                      ^^^^^^^^^ effecttsgo(redundant-schema-tag-identifier): Identifier 'Preview' is redundant since it equals the _tag value.
*/
    value: Schema.String
  }) {}
```
